detail.longDescription: Hi Hackernews, This is my go at an important issue which is making sure agents stick to their rules and context. After using agents and learning from the community on reddit, I decided to have a go at some of the most important problems surrounding how agents are built and deployed in production. This is meant to be a control layer for agents. It gives the agent an identity, policy, and a vault that holds the important sensitive keys used in monetary and high consequential actions. While also allows developers and business owners to query the agents to know what happened, which agent did what, and what business value did it bring to the table. Another important feature is that developers or managers of their agents can undo actions that were gotten wrong my their agents such as deleting tables in a db or a transaction. Their is alot of goodies, dig deep and let me know what you think. fyi, the project seems to have gone far already. Its not a funded project yet parading as a tool. This was due to my obsession with perfection. Even my tools tend to look like finished products. We live in a capitalist society by the way. Have a swing guys!!
